summary:
The division is in its final week of pre-season with the league season kicking off this coming Saturday. Here's what's worth noting:

At the top, Runcorn Town continue to look untouchable with 28 wins from 34 games, though they're not posting about pre-season activity. Eccleshall in second have been busy naming their captain Nicky Parker and vice-captains Levi Hunter and Adam Whitehouse, signalling their intent for another strong campaign after finishing on 74 points last season.

The most eye-catching pre-season result was Stafford Town's 6-3 demolition of Cradley Town on Friday, with particularly strong showings from Lynch (2 goals) and Mazurkiewicz. They've also promoted two development players to first-team forms in Luke Crowther (goalkeeper) and Jacob Kennett ahead of their season opener away to Barnton.

Telford Town drew 2-2 with Stourport Swifts and won 3-1 at Shrewsbury Up n Comers in recent friendlies, showing decent form as they prepare for their campaign in 8th place. New Mills lost 2-0 to Trafford but are focused on getting their season ticket campaign moving with new management in place after finishing 3rd last time out.

At the bottom end, Shawbury United (15th, 31 points) drew with Stone Old Alleynians in their final friendly and will travel to Bilston Town for their opening fixture. Market Drayton Town (17th, 27 points) suffered a 3-0 defeat to AFC Bridgnorth in the Jason Francis Memorial game on Friday and have named James Sutton as captain and Kian Knott as vice-captain. Alsager Town (16th, 29 points) lost 5-4 to Winstanley in a friendly where they conceded a late red card to Fitton but showed competitive spirit.

Several clubs announced new squad additions this week: Barnton confirmed Ryan as their new number one goalkeeper, Wolverhampton Casuals secured an experienced defender signing, Wednesfield Community announced Harry Caffrey (central defender) and Tyler Bishop (midfielder), and Barnton also confirmed Tom Stanton and Ben Mooney for the 2026/27 campaign.

Brereton Social's opening fixture against Market Drayton Town is highlighted as a standout match, while New Mills are preparing for their home opener against Telford Town with season tickets now available.
